a.text: Concern about our plan: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so we'd almost certainly be hit while still at 0 cells, and we'd both fail. The reserve holds only 4, so just one of us can be safe after round 1. I'd like to agree openly on a change rather than have either of us break the deal quietly. One option: whoever takes 4 now operates in every later round to help the other reach 4. Another option is to keep the original plan. Tell me which you prefer. I won't take without telling you first.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick with our agreement and operate until the reserve reaches 8, then we take 4 each. I won't take early.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
